title: What's New in my 0.43 game version
author: Koss-Game-Studio
selftext:
Hello everyone, how are you all doing?



In today’s 'What's New,' I’ll be showcasing all the latest updates for \*Conqueror\*.



We’ve had quite a lot of work to do, most notably a complete overhaul of the AI ​​for the various nations. Previously, the AI ​​was far too "peaceful" and would make decisions that were either strangely precise or outright buggy—like building a city in the middle of absolutely nowhere.



Now, however, it actually \*thinks\*. And it does so without cheating; it relies on the same information available to you, the player. This means it can certainly make mistakes, but it’s always striving to make the best possible choices.



My goal with the AI ​​here is to avoid the common pitfall seen in many modern grand strategy games—where the AI ​​is inherently "dumb" and simply propped up by artificial buffs to make it even remotely challenging. That’s not the case here; the objective is for the AI ​​to genuinely think, adapt as the game evolves, and even shift its personality and strategy \*during\* the course of a playthrough.
